slots.name: subject
slots.meaning: The person or character who is misidentifying something, typically one who should know better, or is in a position of authority or expertise

slots.name: object
slots.meaning: The object that is being misidentified

slots.name: misidentification
slots.meaning: A question in the form, 'Is this a/an [X]?', where [X] is a humorous or absurd misidentification of the object
